frontmatter.author: Paul Serban
frontmatter.title: Essential Tools and Technologies for a JavaScript Developer
frontmatter.subheading: A Guide to the Tools and Technologies Every JavaScript Developer Should Have in Their Toolkit
frontmatter.excerpt: JavaScript is one of the most widely used programming languages in the world, powering everything from simple websites to large-scale distributed systems. This brutally honest guide breaks down the essential tools and technologies every JavaScript developer actually needs, why they matter, and where the industry hype should be ignored.
